global_install_paths.notes: Pi local package materialization path uses ~/.config/pi-coding-agent (or APPDATA on Windows) before invoking 'pi install <local-package-dir>'

extension_manifest_schema.notes: Working package shape uses package.json top-level 'pi' manifest with pi.extensions + pi.skills

lifecycle_hooks.notes: Official Pi hooks are covered by deterministic runtime harness execution in CI (`internal/setup/TestPiExtensionRuntimeHarnessDeterministic`) plus manual Pi smoke checks for real host parity.

compaction_hook_payload.notes: Compaction hooks are validated in deterministic runtime harness for instruction injection and graceful fallback behavior; manual `/compact` smoke tests remain recommended for upstream version drift checks.

notification_api.notes: Official Pi ctx.ui.notify primitive is used for startup memory-available notices and compaction recovery notifications; startup remains notify-only with no automatic context injection.
